source:
Component(dsl: 1, id: "test/states-and-actions", name: "states-and-actions", kind: Kind.section, description: "Golden case",
  states: [NumberState(name: "count", default: 0), BoolState(name: "open", default: "yes"), StringState(name: "bad name", default: "")],
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build: Column(children: [Button(label: "a", onTap: SetState(state: "count", value: "text")), Button(label: "b", onTap: Toggle(state: "count")), Button(label: "c", onTap: SetState(state: "missing", value: 1)), Button(label: "d", onTap: Actions(actions: [SetState(state: "count", value: state.count + 1), ShowMessage(message: "Hi"), Navigate(to: Route.menu)])), Button(label: "e", onTap: AddToCart(product: product, quantity: 1))]))])
